summary: Play 600 original Sudoku puzzles with pencil notes, undo and saved games.
release_notes: Headings are a step smaller, small print such as hints and dates a step larger, and there is more room under the top bar.
page_description: Play 600 original Sudoku puzzles, 200 at each of three difficulties, each with exactly one solution. Pencil notes, undo, an optional mistakes check, and saved games survive reopening.
